messages:
katie: Heads-up: planning a short cutover for the 'slate' dedicated GPU pool tonight 21:00 PT. This will roll a new autoscale policy (lower minscale for low-priority slices + tighter burst caps). Expect ~5–10m of throughput instability during warmup. Please confirm owners and smoke checks.
sergio: I can own the rollout and rollback steps. Will monitor latency dashboards and tail errors.
mike: Quick question — what are the exact minscale/burst values? Need them for the canary routing rule.
katie: New policy: minscale=2 -> minscale=1 for the small slice, burst_limit=250 -> 150. Canary target: 5% traffic to a single pool. If canary looks good after 10m we flip.
anya: I can run the smoke checklist and validate key prompt latencies + KV cache hit rate. Kick me the canary pool id.
katie: Canary pool id is slate-canary-3. Smoke checklist (quick):
```
1) kubectl -n slot get pods -l pool=slate-canary-3  # check ready count
2) curl -sS https://deploy.internal/health?pool=slate-canary-3  # expect 200
3) run loadgen small_workload.yaml --duration=5m --rps=20
4) tail -n 200 /var/log/serving/slate-canary-3.log | grep -i error
```
mike: Rollback steps noted: set autoscale policy back to previous profile, scale up minscale to 2, and trigger pool drain then reattach traffic. Also add a fallback route to the evergreen pool. I'll prepare the rollback patch now.
sergio: FYI: I'll watch per-route p95 and token cost, will post snapshots at +5m and +12m.
deploy-bot: Deploy queue updated: ticket INFRA-1287 placed in slot 21:00 PT. Live link: https://deploy.internal/queue/INFRA-1287
anya: After smoke I'll post a short summary: latencies, error counts, cache hit %. If anything >2x p95 or error spike >0.5% we rollback. :thumbsup:
katie: Perfect. If no objections by 20:30 PT we'll proceed. Tag me if you need to delay. Thanks all.
